Secured business loan

After this lesson you can:
  • Add collateral machinery to business underwriting
  • Walk title, valuation, LTV and perfection

1. The product

An MSME term loan backed by mortgaged property. Everything from the MSME term loan applies, plus the collateral pipeline: ownership and title search, independent valuation, LTV policy against market value, insurance with assignment, and perfection — registering the charge with CERSAI so the security interest is enforceable and visible to other lenders.

The reward is cheaper, larger credit; the price is a slower journey with legal opinions and valuation reports on the critical path.

2. What a BA watches

Perfection evidence before disbursement is the make-or-break control — an unperfected mortgage is barely security at all. At the other end, security release at closure (documents returned, CERSAI satisfaction filed) is dual-controlled and time-bound; module 5's closure checklist applies with force.

Knowledge check

1. Why must CERSAI registration precede disbursement?

  1. Tax reporting
  2. Unperfected security is unenforceable and invisible to other lenders — the collateral barely exists legally
  3. CERSAI charges late fees
  4. Valuation expires
Show answer

B. Perfection is what turns a promise of security into an enforceable, publicly visible interest; evidence-before-disbursement is the contract's rule.
